_comment: Step 14.37: «فهرست نسخ خطی دامغان», the handwritten catalogue of the Al-Javad institute (Mashhad, 421 pages) by Sayyed Jafar Hosseini Ashkevari, edited by Mostafa Derayati, which Fankha cites «ف مخ»: one volume, two parts, Fankha's rows 273 (Fathali Beyg / Sadeqiyeh) and 274 (Qamar Bani Hashem). Its copies of Qamar Bani Hashem were on that library's printed catalogue (catalogue-f4c7fcede840, MTIF 34219, 186 pages), which keeps its own («ف»). Only the two libraries' copies: «ف مخ» is every handwritten catalogue's.
